articles.title: Niger or Nigeria? India probes soybean imports over suspected tax evasion, sources say
articles.summary: Indian customs officials are currently examining a notable uptick in soybean imports, which are purportedly sourced from Niger. Authorities suspect that these shipments are actually originating from Nigeria to avoid applicable tariffs. As a result, importers must now validate the authenticity of their cargoes or incur significant duties. This scrutiny has effectively paused purchases labeled as from Niger, leading to potential delays for goods en route and altering trade dynamics.
